---
title: "Pablo Knobel appointed Instructor"
date: 2026-07-01
categories: [Appointment]
description: "Pablo joined the faculty of the Department of Environmental Medicine at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai as Instructor."

Following his postdoctoral fellowship (2021–2026), Pablo was appointed Instructor in the Department of Environmental Medicine at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai.
